_comment: Copy this, fill in your people, pass via --roster.
Only github_login is required. 'id' defaults to the login and is used as
the output filename key -- set it to your internal alias if you have one.
identity_evidence is strongly recommended: a login is not a person, and a
missing value is marked UNDOCUMENTED in the output.

people.name: Octo Cat
people.title: Software Engineer
people.identity_evidence: Internal directory lists GitHub handle 'octocat' for ocat. Directly documented.

people.name: Sam Person
people.identity_evidence: Profile name + company match only; no explicit mapping doc found. MEDIUM confidence.

NO name field on the GitHub profile. Mapped by login-pattern resemblance to the internal alias plus activity overlap with their team's repos. This is INFERENCE -- confirm with the person before using this file in a review.
